items.q: Can I use an e-wallet for the deposit?
items.a: No. Deposits by e-wallet do not qualify. Use a debit card, bank transfer or Apple Pay.

items.q: I forgot to enter the code. What now?
items.a: Contact Vantro support within 7 days of registering; they can add the offer if you have not placed a bet yet.

items.q: Can I set limits before I play?
items.a: Yes. You can set deposit limits during sign-up and change them in your account at any time.
